method: truth-blind cluster-aware precision projection. The P1.11 clustered interval is used to infer a design effect, which is then applied at the P1.13 positive-call count. Uses P1.11 aggregate/isolate-level data only; no P1.13 truth, call or score exists.
assumptions: contigs per isolate scale with genome size
recall and PPV as in P1.11 for projecting the positive-call count
between-isolate dispersion equal to that implied by the P1.11 interval
interpretation: If the true PPV is 0.950 the lower bound cannot clear 0.95 by construction. At 0.960 it is marginal. Only near 0.966 does a confidence-bound demonstration become likely. This is a HEURISTIC PLANNING PROJECTION, not a formal power calculation and not a gate.

gate_distinction.the_frozen_gate_is: the observed frozen estimand: selective PPV >= 0.95 and selective recall > 0.50 for v1.2-General over the complete cohort, with the P1.11 coverage gate unchanged
gate_distinction.that_is_NOT: a requirement that the lower confidence bound exceed 0.95
gate_distinction.must_not_be_substituted: passing the gate on the point estimate and demonstrating PPV > 0.95 by a confidence-bound criterion are different claims and are reported separately
gate_distinction.no_promise: P1.13 is not promised to demonstrate PPV >= 0.95
